reviewCharts.warning: Montana native review rows use official precinct-level presidential vote-share screening and President-versus-U.S. Senate same-party drop-off screening from the Secretary of State precinct workbook. The workbook does not include 27 presidential write-in votes listed in the separate write-in canvass, so native result rows are 27 votes below the statewide certified presidential total.

turnout.notes: Montana turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout denominator artifact is collected.
